utils.prompt_templates module¶

Prompt construction for Gemini interactions.

utils.prompt_templates.build_chat_prompt(user_question: str, df: DataFrame, stats: dict[str, Any], conversation_history: list[dict[str, str]] | None = None) → str[source]¶

Build a prompt for a user question about the uploaded data.

Includes a compact data representation (aggregate stats + sample) rather than the full raw dataset, to keep the prompt size manageable. Optional conversation_history adds context for follow-up questions.

utils.prompt_templates.build_comparison_prompt(question: str, df_a: DataFrame, df_b: DataFrame, label_a: str, label_b: str, stats: dict[str, Any]) → str[source]¶

Build a comparison prompt for side-by-side analysis.

utils.prompt_templates.build_summary_prompt(df: DataFrame, stats: dict[str, Any], quality_report: Any = None) → str[source]¶

Build a prompt asking Gemini to generate a plain-language data summary.

Cached for 5 minutes since the summary prompt is deterministic for the same dataset.

utils.prompt_templates.detect_chart_request(gemini_response: str) → dict[str, str] | None[source]¶

Parse [CHART:{json}] token from Gemini response, with keyword fallbacks.

Tries JSON config first (Gemini-suggested). Falls back to keyword heuristics for backward compatibility with older-style responses. Returns dict with chart config or None.
